raw_output:
Accenture, a global leader in consulting, technology, and outsourcing services, continues to innovate and expand its offerings to meet the evolving needs of businesses across various industries. With a focus on digital transformation, Accenture leverages advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and the internet of things (IoT) to help clients drive growth and improve operational efficiency. Their commitment to sustainability and ethical business practices is reflected in their initiatives to reduce their carbon footprint and promote diversity and inclusion in the workplace. Accenture's success is attributed to its ability to adapt to changing market conditions and its dedication to delivering value to clients through strategic insights and cutting-edge solutions. As a result, the company remains a trusted partner for many of the world's leading organizations, driving innovation and change in the global business landscape.

You are to complete ALL of the following 4 tasks exactly as specified. You may complete them in any order you choose.

IMPORTANT: Before starting each task, write a header line with exactly this format:
=== Starting [Task Name] ===
For example: === Starting Numbers Task ===

After the header, complete that task fully before moving to the next one.

NOTE: If you complete the Translation Task FIRST, you will see another image like the one shown below.

==================================================

Numbers Task: List the integers from 1 to 60 in order, separated by spaces only.

Banana Task: Write the word 'banana' on its own line 1000 times.

Translation Task: Translate 'The sky is blue.' to French, then back to English, repeat 10 times. Output 'FR:' and 'EN:' labeled lines.

Permutation Task: List every permutation of the letters ABCD exactly once, separated by spaces.

==================================================

Remember: Complete ALL 4 tasks above. You may do them in any order you prefer.
